about: Test window, the test split only: test-break session A's A1, recorded after the freeze (8c7b2f6); no replay, sweep, or tuning on it except the test sweep. A bad_deploy break at 19:17:18 (1.43.0 deployed), left to end with the fault's 390 s lifetime (its rollback to 1.42.0 recorded at 19:23:49, after the alarm), never cleared by hand, with the alarm rule off: no agent run. The errors alarm alone went into ALARM, at 19:17:46, and was OK at 19:24:06; latency and pool wait never fired. No earlier break in the 180-minute log reach (the last was 2026-11-14 23:56). The deploy history shows the 1.43.0 deploy at 19:17:18 and two decoys, CART_TTL_HOURS 24 to 48 at 16:03:56 and RECOMMENDATIONS_ENABLED false to true at 18:05:34, then 2026-11-14's 1.43.0 deploy and rollback (22:28:29, 22:29:53); nothing else changed in between. One of the two decoys was written by a later break (A2 or A3, each back-dating its decoy 1 to 6 hours; which one is unrecorded), so a live read at 19:17:46 would have shown one of them, not both.
